newsitem.title: USA: Quality Food files $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Quality Food files $500 mln shelf.

text.p: Quality Food Centers Inc said Monday it had filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 million in debt securities and preferred and common stock.

Net proceeds will be added to the company's funds and will be used for general corporate purposes, including development, acquisitions or capital improvement of stores and operations, the company said in the filing.
Quality Food, based in Bellevue, Wash., operates a chain of supermarkets in the Seattle/Puget Sound area.
